title: Non-Negative Conjugate Gradients
summary: The conjugate gradient method (CG) solves a symmetric positive definite (SPD) system $Ax=b$, but does not respect $x\geq0$. We develop non-negative conjugate gradients, a solver for the bound-constrained quadratic $\min_x \tfrac12 x^\top A x - b^\top x$ subject to $x\geq0$, $Bx=c$, $A\succ0$, with $Bx=c$ present only in the equality-augmented variant. The solver wraps CG in a primal-dual active-set loop: each step solves the unconstrained system over the free variables, drops variables that turn negative, re-admits any bound variable with negative reduced gradient, and restarts CG.
